workunit: P229 Profile C disposable non-production AI Search BM25 evaluation path

profile_c.implementation: Opt-in isolated Cloudflare AI Search keyword-only BM25 runner using the existing development gold cohort and benchmark bundle contract; no production RetrievalBroker route or production profile is changed.
profile_c.runtime_controls: Requires SPEC229_EVAL_DISPOSABLE=1, pinned clean SOURCE_SHA, account ID and API token; only spec229-eval-* instance IDs are accepted; private endpoint disabled; API token is only sent as Bearer auth and is never written to observations.
profile_c.corpus_security: Repository-only MIT development cohort, digest/revision checked, tenant and ACL metadata filters, cross-tenant and same-tenant private ACL positive/negative canaries; any foreign, stale or ownership-mismatched result aborts.
profile_c.latency: Measured per query around actual provider search calls when runtime is available.
profile_c.cost: NOT_EVALUABLE: no billable per-query usage was returned or measured; null is recorded, never treated as zero.
profile_c.provider_observations: NOT_RUN: dedicated non-production account/token/runtime variables are not available in this session.
profile_c.production_behavior: Unchanged; no production configuration, index or consumer routing was modified.
profile_c.metrics: Actual query observations are evaluated with calculateRetrievalBenchmarkMetrics and emitted as developmentMetrics; releaseGate remains NOT_EVALUABLE for this non-release-approved development cohort.

dataset.source: Existing 560-query development candidate pool; deterministic corpus source paths and digests validated.
dataset.source_use: Owner-authorized repository MIT development evaluation only; no tenant or production data.
